summary: Show installed Explorer identity and distinguish prepared deployment versions in status
details: Add version, --version and version --json without requiring Docker or a prepared deployment; report the selected release version, source revision and directory, keeping development and missing legacy metadata explicit.

Show installed and prepared versions, network identity, ingress, faucet state and a compact container table. Explain mismatched versions without treating prepared configuration as proof of the running image version or indexing readiness.

Add status --json with public metadata, image references and container observations while omitting private RPC URLs, credentials and container commands. Preserve metadata and return a nonzero exit code when Docker status cannot be read.
Keep existing deployment manifests and the usdb-public alias compatible; status/version do not rewrite configuration, start Docker or change services.
operator_actions: After installing this release, use usdb-explorer version and status to compare the selected tool with an existing prepared deployment; these diagnostics do not require preparing or restarting that deployment.

Use status --json for automated inventory instead of parsing the previous raw Compose table. Review the target release notes before applying a version mismatch with the normal deployment replacement workflow.
